description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. develops semiconductor and communications technologies, including SoCs and RF chips. The Verification Software Engineer will develop and enhance validation content and scalable automation frameworks for pre- and post-silicon system-level validation, working across hardware and software boundaries to debug and improve silicon quality. The role may focus on modem, RF, or high-speed SERDES validation, including test infrastructure, driver development, concurrency testing, and failure analysis.
Baseband, RF, and SERDES verification engineer building C/Python test frameworks and debugging hardware failures.

Responsibilities:
• Design and enhance digital baseband verification code
• Work with Modem HW designers to create C/Python code to test HW engines
• Build infrastructure for:
• Functional verification of the baseband HW that can be leveraged into performance tests
• Concurrency and stress testing
• Improve framework capabilities for:
• Reproducibility and debug turnaround
• Performance and scalability across SKUs/platforms
• Analyze & debug failures
• Design and enhance digital baseband verification code
• Work with RF HW designers to create C/Python code to test HW engines from System Vectors
• Build infrastructure for:
• Functional verification of the RF HW that can be leveraged into performance tests
• Concurrency and stress testing
• Improve framework capabilities for:
• Reproducibility and debug turnaround
• Performance and scalability across SKUs/platforms
• Analyze & debug failures
• Design and enhance scalable validation frameworks for:
• Bring-up a high-speed digital link. Basic understanding of Digital to analog/SERDES environment
• Develop and create a Logging and failure analysis
• Collaborate with the SERDES and digital designers to translate analog/digital requirements into C code
• Build infrastructure for:
• Driver development of the (custom) High Speed link
• Concurrency and stress testing
• Improve framework capabilities for:
• Reproducibility and debug turnaround
• Performance and scalability across SKUs/platforms
• Analyze & debug failures

Requirements:
• This position is not eligible for Qualcomm immigration sponsorship
• BS in Electrical, Computer Science, or the equivalent
• open to new graduates and individuals with a few years of experience
• SoC/System Validation Expertise – End-to-end pre-silicon and post-silicon validation, bring-up, system integration, and silicon debug
• Hardware-Software Co-Debug – Strong debugging across SoC architecture, embedded software, firmware, drivers, and hardware interfaces
• Validation Content & Framework Development – Design scalable test content, automation frameworks,  analysis, and debug infrastructure
• Low-Level Programming – Proficiency in C/C++, Python, Assembly, Linux, device drivers, and bare-metal software development
• Pre-Silicon Platforms – Experience with simulation, emulation (Veloce/FPGA), RTL understanding, and validation readiness
• Knowledge of Modem, RF or SERDES high speed interfaces , clock/power management, low-power modes, and performance architecture
• Performance, Power & Concurrency Analysis – System-level validation of bandwidth, latency, QoS, throughput, scalability, and power-performance tradeoffs
• AI-Driven Validation – Applying AI learning/ML to improve validation/debug and log analysis productivity
• AI- Driven code development – Use your coding skills to guide the AI model to create consistent high quality code for drivers, test plans , debug etc
• Lab & Debug Tools – Hands-on experience with JTAG, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, kernel debuggers, and silicon debug methodologies
• Technical Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration – Work effectively across architecture, design, firmware, software, and validation teams to drive silicon quality
• General understanding of Modem baseband purpose and layer 1 processing (I/Q, Symbols, bits)
• Working understanding of RF baseband (y1y2, I/Q) and IF functionality for 4/5/6G processing
• Working understanding of RF front end and RF test equipment
• Basic understanding of Digital to analog/SERDES environment
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field
